notes.title: Development Diary.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This is a devlog related to the development of the game. The project is currently about 75–85% complete. I'll briefly describe the current progress:

[b]Animation System:[/b]
The development and integration of a new, more advanced animation system is almost complete — it's now in the final polishing phase. The new system supports adaptive modes, making the animations much more flexible and realistic compared to what was shown in the latest gameplay trailer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776046/8f6b7458fa6a53f9dbd38115895ea001e83d7b69.png[/img]

[b]Storyline:[/b]
I'm working on more detailed cutscenes and story dialogues for the Story mode. The goal is to make the narrative more engaging and deeper, increasing the player's immersion. Side quests are also being worked on, some of which will be available in the Echo multiplayer mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776046/729f2e8f0adc89961664d52bdfa7f3b958d4e4bf.gif[/img]

[b]Game Content:[/b]
A lot of work is being done on post-processing, level design, and the open world. I'm also optimizing models and materials, replacing them with more modern versions and implementing next-gen technologies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776046/5f612bbbda0365dd4926aaaa54f082efdf6a17aa.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776046/ad734264dfccfb40fc043cc4d3fc39b81fa77e23.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776046/c0e93bfa4290d21dcf46107711cf7d11dcd02d64.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776046/880e75d7e093e91698ce500c24823b38b56a08f0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776046/474ff008195a8c1fe7cd6ca931fd97f53d1181be.png[/img]

[b]Interactive Objects:[/b]
Hundreds of interactive elements have been added: resources, ingredients, gear, tools, workbenches, building materials, and objects for farming and gardening. All of this adds interactivity and opportunities to the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776046/aca93038b4d34d621b712941a8b558ce4a3dd4d3.png[/img]

[b]Anomalies & Action Systems:[/b]
Significant progress has been made on anomaly systems, and active development continues on the action component involving weapons. While the game isn't a traditional shooter, it doesn’t restrict the use of firearms, letting players combine survival and combat styles freely.
New vehicle systems and proper replication for online co-op are also being worked on, along with improvements to other core mechanics related npcs.
Test footage:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776046/8172dc57315b53e99bd546400e1ff581b9af2efa.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776046/60bf41013f74555e53c8416903183a7cea555faf.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776046/8e2ffebc8ba21b300d8b5d4caae23b2c272408a6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776046/ed43dfd24e805103c93a682dec026e976d4fd9a0.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776046/c37fca247b70e389d07abe079b53ab8cdef6a825.gif[/img]

A new gameplay trailer and demo version will definitely be released closer to launch — stay tuned!
Thank you so much for your support. Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist! :)
Wishing you a great mood and see you soon!

notes.title: SPRYDITE development news
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The project is gradually evolving and is nearing its final form. Some elements are undergoing significant changes — for example, the animation system, HUD interface, and level design of certain open areas are being completely reworked. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776046/8b8285c8533b2e20fdadc3b8dfe4419feb550f81.png[/img]


Recently, I’ve also focused on integrating the core game systems to enhance the interaction between different elements. One of these systems is PSIICH, which is an in-game system responsible for synchronizing various aspects of the game, such as survival, resource gathering, and interaction with the environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776046/2c760493281459713db8bea4d1971e7dcb28e095.png[/img]

notes.title: SPRYDITE: Survival information Video Guide #1
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=9uvBOiNx0zE;full][/previewyoutube]

A survival video guide #1 from Mediadoc entertainment, a fictional studio from the SPRYDITE game universe. Mediadoc entertainment has previously specialized in creating TV series and successful animated documentaries about survival in the area of Wandering Horizon.

In Sprydite, players will have the opportunity to improve their character's performance and acquire additional skills, unlocking new abilities through the pumping of skill cells. Timur is a character that represents a variety of illustrations of these skills.

Timur, as a character, is a mascot of Mediadoc entertainment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776046/ab06b3ebc040f7c466c3a63a5cfc0cda0acf31e8.png[/img]

notes.title: Multiplayer Testing!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! We tested the multiplayer mode with friends, and the results were awesome. We had an exciting and interesting adventure where we explored and survived in the world of Sprydite for 5 in-game days. Once I refine and improve all the core mechanics, animations, and the game world, I will record gameplay for demonstration.
